key_insight: ContextRL teaches LLMs to pay attention to the right evidence inside long or multimodal contexts, improving reasoning without directly supervising only the final answer. The key breakthrough is an indirect auxiliary RL objective that helps models find decisive details in text traces and images more reliably.
problem_solved: LLMs often struggle when the correct answer depends on spotting a small but important clue buried in a long context, tool trace, or image. This paper addresses the weakness in long-horizon reasoning and multimodal understanding where irrelevant information can distract the model.
method: Uses context-aware reinforcement learning to reward behavior that focuses on relevant evidence within the input context.
Introduces an indirect auxiliary objective instead of relying only on final-answer supervision.
Trains the model to better identify and use decisive details across text and multimodal settings.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this offers a practical way to make LLMs more reliable on real-world tasks with long documents, tool use, and multimodal inputs. It can improve performance on harder reasoning problems where success depends on finding the right evidence, not just generating fluent answers.

paper_title: Context-Aware RL for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs
